what: By-eye judgements for the 2026-10-18 dataset report, made on the contact sheets of scripts/audit_dataset_sheets.py (220 px tiles of the camera preview / TIFF / JPEG; frozen files not shown). Judged: is unexposed film visible next to the picture (rebate, gap to the next frame, edge print or sprocket holes in film; a black holder or a film-free white background does not count), and is the file a negative at all. Tile size limits the call; 'unclear' is kept separate and not counted as rebate.
reviewer: Claude (session of 2026-10-18), not yet checked by the user
